result: {"ratings": {"Maya": {"rating": 4, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Maya stayed communicative and cooperative throughout, owning the bottom line until it went wrong, handing it over gracefully, clearing the stray drop, and backing off when asked, though her first bottom-line attempt curved the wrong way and cost time."}, "Tom": {"rating": 4, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Tom built the tail pieces and the upright, owned the jammed low arm, and held clear communication about what he was and wasn't touching, though the upright took long enough that the top corner nearly ran out of time."}, "Leo": {"rating": 3, "familiarity": "closely", "why": "Leo was clear in his updates and owned up quickly to lifting good dominoes by mistake, but his joins at the splits mostly didn't fit, that mistake cost the low arm a patch, and he spent much of the time inspecting and commenting rather than building."}}}
